summary: Victory Capital Holdings filed a Form 8-K reporting its assets under management (AUM) as of May 31, 2026, via a press release. Total AUM stood at $338.9 billion, with other assets of $3.6 billion, for total client assets of $342.4 billion. No specific price per share, premium, deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors are mentioned. This is a routine monthly AUM disclosure, not a special situation event. There are no structural changes, regulatory clocks, or risk-arb angles to monitor.
